items.difficulty_reason: The full principal-block Galois criterion removes composition-factor restrictions through a character-theoretic induction combining principal-block control, Galois-stable character extension/induction, minimal-height arguments and deep primitive-permutation/simple-group structure inputs. All original finite G, prime p, principal block B0 and precise J automorphism-set definitions retained. Old Part2 concerns the stronger all-Omega-invariant-character hypothesis and a structural p-residual decomposition in Theorem B, not the principal-block Sylow conclusion. Theorem B and its critique/discussion retained as author context without independent review or extra count.
